playerIdentity: T2-A isolated test player; never a real account
sourceGeometry: unchanged accepted player and G007 source meshes; high-reference atlas, three candidate GLB LODs
assembly: Select body-base, remove only conservative body patches for actually available selected slots, add selected independent slot pixels. Sort visible fragments by per-pixel depth (near first), then alpha composite. Never use a global painter order for moving weapons or feet.
alignment: Each atlas frame trim is an original 256x256 source rectangle. Place frame using its pivot, which may lie outside the trim; trim origins must not be discarded. Original ground pivot is in actor metadata. Depth is normalized linear camera distance: 6+8*u metres; transparent depth 65535.
frameTiming: 22 samples at ticks 0..21, 30fps, inclusive 700ms endpoint. GLB B2 tracks start at 1/30s, end at 22/30s; elapsed is sampleTime minus clipStart. Do not add initial GLB offset or extra endpoint hold to the common 700ms clock.

camera.gltfCoordinates: right-handed +Y up +Z forward; convert baked Blender x,y,z to x,z,-y

scale: Use the same locked controls actor-height ratio and original-frame projection for all schemes; never normalize each trimmed slot to actor height. Portrait Boss cap and HUD remain mandatory.
quality: A uses the same high-reference art and visible silhouette; quality tiers must control common visible pixel budget. Three 3D candidate LODs retain original rig/G007 binds. Low/medium-specific A re-bakes are not delivered or claimed.

fallback.rule: Mixed fixture remains geometry-fallback metadata; do not render G007 as G006. Offline QC shows uncovered base plus unavailable diagnostic. B3 must use an explicitly generic approved common fallback or text-only degradation; no completed G006 visual claim.
fallback.empty: No slot pixels; restore corresponding original body patch

effectAliases: Six real base clips only. Known crit/counter can use the attack pose plus a shared visual cue; known combo requires source-driven repeats. Drain has no dedicated clip. Do not create source events, infer HP or claim new formal skills.
